- Produce professional presentations and supporting documents that clearly communicate the company's offering and commercial value.
- Interpret client briefs and develop compelling proposals that help convert enquiries into business opportunities.
- Work closely with the team to support sales activity and ensure proposals are delivered accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Use creative thinking to develop engaging ways of presenting information and differentiating the company's offering.
- Support the preparation of quotations, commercial documentation and client-facing materials as required.
- Maintain a professional and consistent standard across all sales proposals and communications.
Business Coordination & Administration
- Coordinate multiple projects and priorities, ensuring deadlines and commitments are met.
- Maintain organised records, documentation and business information.
- Support the preparation of reports, business documents and management information as required.
- Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and make more effective use of technology.
- Liaise with colleagues, clients and external contacts to ensure effective communication and coordination.
- Provide additional administrative and operational support to the business as required.
